author: gurukamath
content: Have tagged a new release for frames. The decision to update the EIP-8037 child frame reservoir semantics was made in ACDC yesterday and it was not included in the previous release. This does not affect the frames specific tests but does make everything fully consistent with the latest glamsterdam spec.

author: gurukamath
content:
🧪  `frames-devnet@v0.3.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-frames-devnet@v0.3.0

We are using this EELS branch for reference: [`devnets/frames/0`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/frames/0)

PTAL at the release notes & the test [release tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3532) for the full scope.
Mainline sync, EIP-8141 spec unchanged at [`EIPs@b75cbe6`](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/b75cbe61150f09a44c38843be916417283d5b7bf/EIPS/eip-8141.md).

**New in v0.3.0:**
- EIP-8037: a successful child merge now repays spilled state gas from the reservoir, fixing `gas_left` after cross-frame refunds (#3478). **This is the change to re-run against.**
- EIP-8037: more cross-frame refund coverage; `CALL_VALUE` derived from `ACCOUNT_WRITE + CALL_STIPEND`.
- EIP-7778: block gas accounting and admission coverage across all transaction types.
